newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini meets Tietmeyer in Rome.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini meets Tietmeyer in Rome.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini and Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer discussed the prospects for European economic and monetary union on Wednesday, the foreign ministry said.
A brief statement said Dini, a former central banker, received Tietmeyer, who is on a private visit to Italy.
It said the two discussed the economic situations in their countries and the "prospects of the third phase of European Economic and Monetary Union."
The European Commission said on Wednesday that only Italy and Greece might miss the deficit target needed to qualify for the European Union's single currency. Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
